name: writing-emit
description: Deterministic emitter core for the writing repo's blog drafts. Resolves a canonical, portable index.md (inlining file= snippets, regenerating LikeC4 PNGs) and renders its rich constructs (::::journey, :::callouts, likec4= images) per target — a rich MDX post for the unitycatalog.io / delta.io sites, or flattened Markdown for the internal md-twin — so a self-contained dist/<target>/ render can be delivered downstream. Reuses the two target-agnostic remark plugins from ../site/src/plugins/ verbatim — one implementation of the snippet extraction and the prose guard. NEVER edits index.md.
